RoNeTC.paper: Reliable Open-Set Network Traffic Classification, IEEE TIFS 2025, DOI 10.1109/TIFS.2025.3544067
findings: all packet views already observed (IP header / transport header / packet payload)
final decision dynamically fuses already-observed views
does NOT selectively acquire previously unobserved runtime evidence

RoeCi.paper: Robust Open-Set Network Traffic Classification, IEEE TMC 2026, DOI 10.1109/TMC.2026.3715471
findings: easy/low-complexity samples use fewer experts; hard samples invoke additional expert capacity
joint uncertainty used for Known/Unknown classification
consequences: do more processing before rejecting Unknown = PRIOR_ART_EXISTS
adds MODEL CAPACITY / COMPUTE to the SAME observation; does NOT acquire previously unobserved Temporal/Relation observation evidence before novelty handling

claim_boundary.ROECI: same observation + adaptive additional model capacity
claim_boundary.OURS: partial/basic observation + adaptive acquisition of previously unobserved runtime-legal observation evidence + reclassification before novelty

GCLC.paper: Graph-Based Contrastive Learning and Clustering for Open-World Encrypted Traffic Classification, IEEE TIFS 2026, DOI 10.1109/TIFS.2026.3705313
consequences: new-class discovery / clustering / update / generic open-world continual evolution = PRIOR_ART_EXISTS
does NOT model Evidence-recoverable Known contamination before unknown-candidate admission

generic_AFA.reference: Li & Oliva, Active Feature Acquisition with Generative Surrogate Models, ICML 2021, PMLR 139
generic_AFA.consequence: generic dynamic Evidence acquisition is NOT our novelty

AFA_plus_OOD.reference: Li et al., Towards Robust Active Feature Acquisition, arXiv:2107.04163
AFA_plus_OOD.consequence: AFA+OOD combination is NOT by itself novel

non_greedy_AFA.reference: Valancius, Lennon, Oliva, Acquisition Conditioned Oracle for Nongreedy Active Feature Acquisition (ACO), ICML 2024, PMLR 235

cost_aware_two_stage.reference: Regol et al., Is the acquisition worth the cost? Surrogate losses for Consistent Two-stage Classifiers, NeurIPS 2025
cost_aware_two_stage.lesson: router cannot see z before deciding; confidence alone is not the theoretically correct routing rule; optimal routing = expected future gain minus cost
cost_aware_two_stage.consequence: expected future acquisition utility is prior art; do not claim utility routing as invention

reference: Guney et al., Active feature acquisition via explainability-driven ranking, ICML 2025
Norcliffe et al., Stochastic Encodings for Active Feature Acquisition, ICML 2025
instance_specific_AFA.consequence: instance-specific Evidence utility is NOT standalone novelty

reference: Active Acquisition for Multimodal Temporal Data, arXiv:2211.05039
typed_temporal_acquisition.consequence: typed/grouped/temporal/jointly-informative acquisition are NOT standalone novelty claims

offline_AFA_evaluation.reference: von Kleist et al., Evaluation of Active Feature Acquisition Methods for Time-varying Feature Settings, JMLR 26(60) 2025

acquire_before_abstain.reference: Xu et al., Look Again Before You Abstain: Budgeted Conformal Evidence Acquisition, arXiv:2606.16667

critical_lesson.detail: post-acquisition score distribution differs from pre-acquisition; never reuse a Basic-only threshold after acquisition; calibration and evaluation observations must traverse the same frozen acquisition pipeline; if policy/budget is selected on calibration data require separate held-out calibration protocol or pre-specified correction
critical_lesson.not_our_novelty: this calibration principle is prior art

C2_CONDITIONAL.name: EVIDENCE_GATED_UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE_PURIFICATION_FOR_SELF_EVOLUTION
C2_CONDITIONAL.precise_scope: remove Evidence-recoverable Known from the unknown-candidate stream BEFORE clustering, human verification, and new-class adaptation
C2_CONDITIONAL.mechanism: uncertain observation -> Evidence recovery -> remove Recoverable Known -> residual novelty -> Unknown candidate stream -> verified feedback -> new-class adaptation

SELF_EVOLUTION.prerequisite: before full continual training, first test whether the Evidence Gate actually purifies the Unknown candidate stream (Unknown-Candidate Purification Gate; no continual model training)

EVIDENCE_SPECIALIZATION_AUDIT.purpose: true-known-class x Evidence family x HELP/HARM/UNIQUE_HELP/NET_UTILITY; within-class heterogeneity

open_world_gate_design_revision.metric_guard: ensure Known recovery does NOT pull True Unknown toward Known
open_world_gate_design_revision.difficulty_routing_rule: utility routing MUST be compared against generic difficulty routing (LOW_CONFIDENCE / HIGH_ENTROPY) per RoeCi prior art
open_world_gate_design_revision.oracle_rule: oracle using actual future outcomes must NEVER be described as deployable
open_world_gate_design_revision.ronec_comparator: RoNeTC-style multi-view dynamic fusion as Related Work comparator

continual_design_revision.attribution_rule: any gain must be attributable to Unknown-stream quality, not a different continual algorithm
